Scylla and Charybdis · after Homer, Book XII

Master render

Renders every frame on this computer's graphics card at full quality, with true motion blur, lens depth of field and anti-aliasing from many samples per frame, then encodes an MP4 with the soundtrack. Keep this tab in front while it runs.

720 frames at 24 fps. A strong desktop GPU does DCI 2K at 16 samples in roughly 15 to 40 minutes; 4K takes about four times as long.

Saving files works when this page is opened on claude.ai in a desktop browser.
